<!-- pr-reviewer: ea23b3e119cfd1abd0b43708ba56d91c5008eaf1 -->
Needs changes before merge.

The browser tests now find rows, eye buttons, and menu items by label. Drag tests use the node rectangles. Both fixed browser-coordinate constants are removed. The decision file explains the change.

Local checks used the trial merge with upstream/main at a277dd9d51e7b4488403b946d0a3234b71ba7504. The merge had no conflicts. No GitHub runner was used.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --no-run` | Passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib`, from `crates/ui` | 864 passed, 0 failed, 6 ignored |
| UI integration suites | 115 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed; no warnings |

Integration suites: `boundary` (3), `boundary_picks` (6), `feedback` (6), `fixtures` (7), `gpu_render` (11; 1 ignored), `machine` (6), `models` (4), `operations` (31), `shell` (21), `sinker_setup` (2), `tap_hand` (3), `theme_files` (14), and `waterjet_tool` (1). All six changed browser tests passed in the unit suite.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/browser_pane.rs:65` and the PR body: Add before and after screenshots to the body. This PR changes the visible browser width. It also includes ribbon and theme changes from #2027. The body has no screenshots. Put the images only on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch, and link them from the body. Do not add images to the PR branch.

Notes:

- This review used the current upstream/main rules, including the current process-version rule.
- The PR changes UI code and themes. It does not change posted G-code, geometry, stock simulation, or collision checks. Safety mutation checks are not required. I did not repeat the author's mutation checks.
- No golden files changed. Ignored pixel snapshot tests were not run.
- #2027 remains open. The body states that #2027 must merge first.
- Non-blocking: `painted.rs` remains above 400 lines and grows by four lines in the browser-label commit.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Fixed the latest review’s screenshot finding. The PR body now shows matching before and after captures for Horizon Day and Teal Night. They show the browser eye column, ribbon, and theme changes from the stack. All four PNGs live only on the fork’s `pr-screenshots` branch at `7136fd458c422fc8d81bceeecfc9eec849819173`.

Pin: `pr2097_before_after_screenshot_links`. Removing a required before-image link fails (RED). Restoring it passes (GREEN). All four links return the captured PNGs.

New head: `9f107493e2f3fbd3f2b5ff3d514d6b017b5b9b05`. This is an empty documentation commit. The reviewed source tree is unchanged.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed: 829 unit tests and 26 integration tests passed, 6 ignored. `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.

Please re-review. The PR remains a draft.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 9f107493e2f3fbd3f2b5ff3d514d6b017b5b9b05 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The earlier screenshot finding is resolved. The body has before and after images for Horizon Day and Teal Night. I downloaded and inspected all four PNGs. They show the browser eye column, ribbon height, and theme ink. The images are on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch. This PR adds no images.

The source tree is unchanged from the earlier reviewed head, `ea23b3e119cfd1abd0b43708ba56d91c5008eaf1`. I also read the full diff against current upstream main. The browser tests use labels and node rectangles. Both fixed browser coordinate constants are removed. The decision files explain the choices.

I repeated the local checks after a trial merge with `upstream/main` at `a277dd9d51e7b4488403b946d0a3234b71ba7504`. The merge had no conflicts. No GitHub runner was used.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --no-run` | Passed |
| `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --lib`, from `crates/ui` | 864 passed; 0 failed; 6 ignored |
| UI integration suites, from `crates/ui` | 115 passed; 0 failed; 1 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed; no warnings |

Integration results: `boundary` 3; `boundary_picks` 6; `feedback` 6; `fixtures` 7; `gpu_render` 11; `machine` 6; `models` 4; `operations` 31; `shell` 21; `sinker_setup` 2; `tap_hand` 3; `theme_files` 14; `waterjet_tool` 1. All passed. The ignored integration test is a pixel snapshot test. All six changed browser tests passed in the unit suite.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes:

- The review uses the current upstream main rules.
- This PR changes UI code and themes. It does not change posted G-code, geometry, stock simulation, or gouge and collision checks.
- Safety mutation checks are not required. I did not repeat the author's mutations.
- No golden files changed. Ignored pixel snapshot tests were not run.
- #2027 remains open. Follow the merge order in the body: merge #2027 first.
- Non-blocking: `painted.rs` remains above 400 lines. The browser label commit adds four lines to it.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
